detail.runner_up_case: The strongest honest case for FALSE is that the record proves a plan, not its execution. Every pre-2026 item (CNBC, Business Insider, YouTube) uses prospective language — 'will become,' 'plans to hand over' — and CEO successions announced for a future date can be delayed, conditioned, or reversed by the board; Buffett also said he would remain chairman and keep his shares, so a skeptic could argue continuity of his control. The only post-transition support is (a) Wikipedia's undated lead sentence saying Abel has been president and CEO 'since January 2026' — a tertiary source whose quote is explicitly flagged NOT verified and which could simply restate the announced schedule — and (b) a single secondary outlet (Observer, Sept 2026) quoting an unverified shareholder letter. Critically, Q3, the verdict-deciding question, asked whether Berkshire's FY2025 Form 10-K or the 2026 DEF 14A explicitly names Abel as CEO, and although a broad sec_edgar search was run, no quote from any actual SEC filing appears in the evidence record; likewise Berkshire's own website (Q2) was never checked directly, and the Horatio Alger bio page could be stale or updated prospectively. On this record the claim rests on scheduled intent plus two unverified post-dated secondary sources, so a diligent red-teamer could honestly hold FALSE: the January 1, 2026 effective date may not have taken effect as announced.
would_flip_it: A Berkshire Hathaway Form 8-K or press release from December 2025–January 2026 stating that the board postponed, conditioned, or canceled the CEO handover, or that Buffett remains chief executive officer.
The FY2025 Form 10-K (filed early 2026) whose signature page or officer certification is signed by Warren E. Buffett as Chief Executive Officer rather than Gregory E. Abel.
The 2026 DEF 14A executive-officers table still listing Buffett as CEO with Abel as vice chairman of non-insurance operations.
Berkshire's official website leadership listing, as captured after January 2026 (e.g., via Wayback), still showing Warren Buffett as chief executive officer.
Credible dated journalism from January 2026 or later reporting that the transition was delayed or that Abel had not assumed the CEO title.
